title: Metalyse Late Time Window – China HA Interaction Strategy (CRM)

background.text: Presented by Leo Bao for content endorsement at PEC on 15 Dec 2025.
background.quote: (E) Metalyse Late Time Window HA interaction strategy Leo Bao

for_endorsement.text: China health authority communication plan for Metalyse Late Time Window submitted for PEC endorsement.

decision.text: PEC endorsed the China HA communication plan. PEC suggested full alignment with global team and that global team understand the uncertainty for NDA approval if China directly submits the CTA without pre-IND consultation to confirm CDE NDA requirements.
decision.quote:
Endorsed
PEC comments:
• PEC endorsed the China health authority communication plan.
• PEC suggested team to fully align with global team for China HA interaction plan and let global team
understand the uncertainty for NDA approval if China directly submits the CTA without the pre-IND
consultation to confirm with CDE on the NDA requirements.

todo.text: Leo Bao to follow up; due Next PEC.

title: Asian Phase 1 Trial on FAP/TRAILR2 in MASH Cirrhosis Patients (CRM) – Julia Zhu

background.text: Presented by Julia Zhu for content endorsement at PEC on 15 Dec 2025. Two scenarios discussed, including Scenario 2 where PMDA requests Asian data but CDE does not.
background.quote: (E) Asian phase 1 trial on FAP/TRAILR2 in MASH cirrhosis patients Julia Zhu

for_endorsement.text: Asian Phase 1 trial on FAP/TRAILR2 in MASH cirrhosis patients submitted for PEC content endorsement.

decision.text: PEC did not endorse. PEC suggested team evaluate the value of enrolling limited Chinese patients against increased resource and operational complexity under Scenario 2 (CDE not request, but PMDA requests Asian data). PEC also suggested clearly clarifying the two consultation questions and whether intensive PK could be waived through this Asian Phase 1. An ad hoc PEC meeting will be planned for further endorsement.
decision.quote:
Not Endorsed
PEC comments:
• PEC suggested team to evaluate the value by enrollment of limited Chinese patients, and the invested resource
and operational complexity increased under scenario 2 (CDE not request, but PMDA request Asian data)
• PEC suggested team to clearly clarify the two questions for consultation, and if an intensive PK could be waived
through this Asian phase 1.
• An ad hoc PEC meeting will be planned for further endorsement.

todo.text: Julia Zhu to address PEC comments and prepare for ad hoc PEC meeting for further endorsement; due Next PEC.
